dndDescription: Pet stays idle, ignores AI events
confirmBubbleDescription: When off, AI tool authorizations stay in the main chat window
notchTaskboxDescription: Built into AionUi. Shows AI session status, task progress, permission prompts, and inline replies at the top notch area. Enabling it turns off Desktop Pet.
topTaskboxDescription: Built into AionUi for Windows. Shows AI session status, task progress, permission prompts, and inline replies in a top-center taskbox. Enabling it turns off Desktop Pet.
notchTaskboxHardwareNotchDescription: Reserves the hidden center area on MacBook displays so compact text is not covered by the physical notch.
desktopPetDisabledByNotchTaskbox: Desktop Pet turns off automatically while Notch Taskbox is enabled
desktopOnly: Desktop Pet is only available in the desktop application. It cannot be used in WebUI browser mode.
